## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-juan **Japanese Tendai-school catalog** of authograph (*zhēnjì* 真跡 = "authentic trace") notebook materials of the **Foundational Great Master** (*gēnběn dàhéshàng* 根本大和尚) — almost certainly **Saichō** 最澄, the foundational master of Japanese Tendai. The Kanripo catalog meta does not specify an author, but the title's "**Foundational Great Master**" wording and the **804–822 dating bracket** (Saichō's Tang return through his death) align the text with Saichō's circle. Preserved at T55 no. 2162.

**Abstract**

The work documents the autograph manuscript-notebooks (*cèzǐ* 策子, "small bound notebooks" in Japanese-Heian convention) and other materials associated with Saichō. *notBefore* = **805**, *notAfter* = **822**. Catalog dynasty 日本.

The work is one of the principal **early-Heian Japanese Tendai documentary materials**, supplementing the canonical importation catalogs ([KR6s0105](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0105)–[KR6s0106](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6s/KR6s0106)) with notebook-and-personal-document materials.
